name: What kind of foundation work is needed for a garage expansion?

mainEntity.name: What kind of foundation work is needed for a garage expansion?

acceptedAnswer.text: The type of foundation work for a garage expansion depends on the soil conditions, the size of the addition, and whether the new structure will support a second story. Common options include slab foundations, stem wall foundations, or sometimes pier and beam foundations. It's crucial that the new foundation is properly integrated with the existing one to prevent future structural issues. Hometelligent conducts thorough site evaluations to determine the most appropriate and compliant foundation solution for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Foundation work varies by soil, expansion size, and if a second story is added. Hometelligent assesses site conditions for proper integration with existing structures.
